description:
A Go compiler, code editor and learning workspace for iPhone and iPad. Write, build, run, test, vet and format Go on your device with the bundled Go 1.27.1 toolchain, even offline.

BUILD REAL PROJECTS
• Edit Go and go.mod with syntax highlighting, completion and keyboard shortcuts.
• Follow compiler diagnostics to their source line and column, and inspect per-case test results.
• Import public GitHub repositories from the app or share sheet, folders from Files, or exported archives.
• Navigate nested folders and grouped module dependencies. Organize projects with folders, tags, favorites and file-name search.
• Download compatible pure-Go modules through the official Go proxy and checksum database. Vendored sources build offline.
• Continue working while downloads run, inspect meaningful failures and retry from Output. Clear downloaded packages from saved user projects without deleting your code.

LEARN AND PRACTICE
• Explore 92 teaching lessons in 15 units, plus 22 prediction challenges. Topics include core Go, structs, collections, interfaces, errors, modules, generics, concurrency and the standard library.
• Read 45 additional worked lessons on slices, cancellation, runtime and GC, goroutines and threads, profiling, HTTP/Gin, Redis and architecture.
• Around Go now has 25 practical lessons: Bash commands and scripts, Git, Go tools, curl, Linux services, Docker, Compose, Podman and Kubernetes.
• Follow Kubernetes contexts, manifests, dry-run and diff, logs and events, Service routing, configuration, probes, scaling and rollback.
• Use compiler-judged exercises, 69 topic-specific visual guides, practical notes, pitfalls and official references.
• Read highlighted Go, shell, Dockerfile and YAML examples. Expand code to full screen; embedded examples scroll with the lesson.
• Match learned concepts in Review, finish multi-round sessions, and work through saved mistakes with three-answer questions and immediate explanations. Progress survives reopening the app.
• Explore Idiom Coach, runnable Concurrency Lab scenarios, Go-generated PNGs and local HTML/CSS/JavaScript previews.

MADE FOR YOUR SCREEN
Keep files, code and a resizable results dock together on iPad. Use collapsible Files and panel switching on iPhone, with compact landscape controls and room for code. On supported iPhone Duo systems, expanded and folded layouts adapt to the display; laptop posture keeps code or Terminal above the horizontal fold and keyboard or results below it.
Choose your theme and text size, optional keep-awake during builds and downloads, and Face ID or device-passcode locking.

PRIVACY AND LIMITS
One paid download. No subscription, app account, analytics or advertising trackers. Projects and learning progress stay local; a chosen Files or iCloud library follows your provider's sync rules. Package search, downloads, imports and external links use the network.

Compiled Go runs in a bounded WebAssembly/WASI sandbox with one writable project directory and no network access. cgo and arbitrary shell commands are unsupported; the terminal exposes app-supported commands. Bash, Git, Docker, Kubernetes and native service examples are learning material for your own development environment. WebKit website previews may load remote resources included by your project.

whatsNew:

• Build and inspect containers with Docker, Compose and Podman. Learn volumes, image registries and target platforms.

Shell, container, cluster and native service examples are for your own development environment; the app's on-device sandbox capabilities are unchanged.
reviewNotes:
GopherForge 1.1.2, build 36. No account or demo credentials are required.

This update adds offline educational content: 92 teaching lessons in 15 units, including 45 read-only worked lessons and 22 separate prediction challenges. Around Go contains 25 practical readings across command line, containers and Kubernetes. These include Bash, Git, Go tooling, curl, Linux/systemd, Docker/Compose/Podman and kubectl workflows. Shell, container, Kubernetes and native service examples are displayed as educational text; they do not enable arbitrary shell processes, cluster access or native networking inside the compiled-program sandbox.

To inspect the new material, open Learn, scroll to Around Go: command line, Around Go: containers or Around Go: Kubernetes, then open a lesson. Examples are syntax highlighted and offer Full screen. Reading completion is explicitly marked by the learner and persists without compilation. Original compiler-judged exercises keep their compiler-based completion requirement. Review uses learned concepts and has a Finish review action after multi-round practice. Fix mistakes uses three answer choices, explanations and persisted corrections.

To try the compiler, open Projects, create a Worker pool project, then open Build and tap Run. Output reports the local build/program result. Package with tests demonstrates per-case results. The project menu exposes Build and Vet; Beautify formats Go.

The bundled Go 1.27.1 toolchain runs locally through a bounded WebAssembly/WASI sandbox. Compiled programs have one writable project directory and no network access. cgo and arbitrary shell commands are not supported. Public repository imports and pure-Go module downloads use the network and official Go proxy/checksum database. Downloads can be retried from Output; Settings can clear downloaded packages from saved user projects without deleting code.

iPhone landscape provides compact controls; iPad has collapsible Files and a resizable results dock. On supported Duo systems the workspace adapts to folded, expanded and laptop displays. This release retains the established Duo keyboard/layout behavior and improves its header.

One paid download, no subscription, sign-in, analytics or advertising trackers. Projects/progress are local subject to the user's selected Files/iCloud provider. WebKit project previews may load project-specified remote resources. Optional Face ID/device passcode and keep-awake controls are in Settings.
